sourceAuthorities: social gameplay and NPC interaction instructions

resolvedFindings.finding: Existing relationship-edge schema exposes one strength number while the later source requires multiple profile-scaled dimensions.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Treat strength as legacy/optional summary and require a compatible dimension-state extension with no guessed migration.

resolvedFindings.finding: Social Bonds could be confused with powers/magic bond definitions.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Keep social Bonds relationship-owned unless explicit cross-domain compatibility is declared.

resolvedFindings.finding: Source register has 154 rows but only four explicit relationship facts.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Preserve absence and prohibit synthetic relationship claims.

resolvedFindings.finding: Graph visualization can leak hidden counterpart identities through topology or API payloads.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Filter server-side before serialization and require list/graph projection parity.

resolvedFindings.finding: Relationship, reputation, status, mood, intent, and stance overlap linguistically.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Lock separate aggregates and ownership boundaries; F016 and F010 consume rather than merge F009 state.
